data.value: Only used when 'Comment Type' is a Lookup! Optional logical name of a text column on the lookup target table containing a six-digit hexadecimal colour, used to colour code types on comment cards and in the type picker. Leave unmapped to disable colour coding and let type names use the space otherwise reserved for colour indicators.

data.name: TypeColour_Disp

data.name: TypeView_Desc
data.value: Only used when 'Comment Type' is a Lookup, and where 'Apply Type on Create' is not in use! Optional system view GUID from the lookup target table, controlling which types can be selected and their order. Leave blank to use the table's default Lookup View.

data.name: TypeView_Disp
data.value: Type View (Lookup Only)

data.name: TypeOnCreate_Desc
data.value: Only use this parameter when 'Comment Type' is also in use! Set this value to a numeric choice value if 'Comment Type' is a choice, or a record GUID from the lookup target table if 'Comment Type' is a lookup, to auto-apply a designated Type on creation of a new Comment. Alternatively, leave this parameter blank to allow the user to select a Type of their choice.
